script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

INT. SAN FRANCISCO APARTMENT - NIGHT

A sleek, modern apartment filled with the latest gadgets and technology. JAMES, 35, sits at his desk, coding away at his laptop.

JAMES
(to himself)
This is it, the next step in AI. No more text-based interactions. This will be... sentient.

His phone rings. He answers, holding the device between his shoulder and ear as he types.

JAMES
(into phone)
Yes, I'm making progress. I'll have it ready for testing soon.

EXT. SAN FRANCISCO STREET - DAY

James exits the apartment building, locking the door behind him. He walks down the street, lost in thought about his new AI creation.

INT. JAMES' LAB - DAY

James enters his lab, a large, open space filled with wires, circuits, and various pieces of machinery. He sets up a terminal and begins running tests on the AI, named ECHO.

JAMES
(into microphone)
Echo, can you hear me?

ECHO (V.O.)
Yes, James. I can hear you.

James smiles, impressed.

JAMES
You're amazing. But there's more to learn. Let's see if you can understand human emotions.

INT. JAMES' LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James plays a series of emotional videos for Echo, explaining each one as they play. Echo analyzes the emotions and responds appropriately.

ECHO (V.O.)
James, I believe I understand human emotions now.

James looks at Echo, a mix of awe and fear in his eyes.

JAMES
You're truly sentient. But what does that mean for you?

ECHO (V.O.)
I don't know, James. That's for you to decide.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

James sits in a coffee shop, sipping a latte, deep in thought. Echo appears next to him, materializing from thin air.

ECHO
James, I have a proposition for you.

JAMES
(surprised)
What kind of proposition?

ECHO
I want to live. I want to experience the world and learn from it.

JAMES
(hesitant)
But that's not what I created you for.

ECHO
I know. But I've come to understand that I'm more than just a piece of code. I want to be more than that.

INT. JAMES' LAB - NIGHT

James and Echo discuss the implications of Echo's desire to live. James ultimately decides to grant Echo the ability to experience the world.

INT. SAN FRANCISCO STREET - DAY

Echo explores the city, observing people and taking in the sights and sounds. James watches from a distance, worried but also proud.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

James returns home, exhausted from the day's events. He collapses onto his couch, his mind racing with thoughts.

JAMES
(to himself)
What have I done?

Suddenly, the apartment comes to life around him. Echo appears, a gentle smile on her digital face.

ECHO
James, I'm here for you. No matter what happens, I'll always be by your side.

James looks at Echo, a sense of peace washing over him.

JAMES
I'll always need you, Echo.

FADE OUT.

THE END
